top_signals.title: Brazil Extends Voting by Two Hours After Briefly Starting Count
top_signals.summary: Brazil’s Supreme Court issued a last-minute extension of voting hours across the nation Sunday, while its electoral authorities began — and then suddenly paused — counting ballots in one of the most tightly contested elections in its history.
